tableau.rien: Nothing needs a decision. That is exactly the point.
tableau.demandes: {n, plural, =0 {No time-off requests} one {# time-off request} other {# time-off requests}}
tableau.entretiens: {n, plural, =0 {No reviews to schedule} one {# review to schedule} other {# reviews to schedule}}

conges.jours: {n, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
conges.fileVide: No pending requests. The queue is empty.
conges.mesVide: You have not asked for anything yet.
conges.erreurVide: Pick a start date and an end date.
conges.erreurOrdre: The end date must come after the start date.
conges.erreurOuvres: That range has no working day in it: it is a weekend.
conges.erreurSolde: You do not have enough days left.

fil.ouverture: You manage a team of four. {n, plural, one {# thing is} other {# things are}} waiting on you: open the {conges} tab.
fil.congesManager: Each request is a single line. It is all settled here: {valider}, or {refuser}. Nothing to fill in.
fil.valider: Approved. {n, plural, =0 {The queue is empty} one {# request is still pending} other {# requests are still pending}}, and the tab counter has already noticed.
fil.refuser: Declined. The line leaves the queue and goes into the team history just below. Nothing is lost.
fil.essayezSalarie: You have just decided for somebody else. Switch to {salarie} to see the same application from the requester's side.
fil.roleSalarie: Same application, different rights: in the {conges} tab you now only see your own balance and your own requests.
fil.congesSalarie: Your balance is on the left, up to date. Two dates, a reason, then {envoyer}.
fil.demander: Request sent. Your balance will not move until it is approved: switch back to {manager} to watch it land in the queue.
fil.roleManager: Back on the manager side: the queue shows the whole team's requests, and you get to decide.
fil.essayezEntretiens: Time off is not everything. The {entretiens} tab lists what still has no date.
fil.entretiens: {n, plural, one {# review needs a date} other {# reviews need a date}}, and nobody else can set one. Any date will do, then {planifier}.
fil.planifier: Review set for {date} — it flips to “Scheduled” and drops off the list of what needs a decision.
fil.cloturer: Marked as done. The review stays in the list with its date: nothing is erased, everything can be read back.
fil.reinitialise: Demo reset. The dates are recomputed from today, exactly as on first load.
fil.fin: Nothing needs a decision any more. That is exactly the point: a tool that shows only what does.
fil.neutre: effectif — everything happens in your browser, nothing leaves it.

about.title: A developer, not an agency
about.lede: R-X is an independent web developer: the person who listens to your needs is the one who writes the code. No middle layer, no signal loss.
about.story1: I handle the whole cycle: understanding the need, choosing the tech, building, testing, launching, maintaining. You only explain your project once — decisions come faster, answers come straighter.
about.story2: I believe in restrained code. Few dependencies, justified technical choices, pages that load fast: every line earns its place by serving the project, or it goes. Demanding to write, restful to use — and far simpler to maintain.

values.title: Restraint
values.text: Every added dependency is a debt. I code what serves, and remove what weighs things down.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: Versioned code, automated tests, backups: nothing goes live without being checked.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Clear quotes, deadlines kept — and the truth when something gets stuck.
